about_the_game:
"Super Hard Game" is a brutally difficult top-down arcade game where even a single mistake means game over.
Play as “Dalddo,” a moon rabbit trying to escape to Earth, while dodging unpredictable threats like missiles, lasers, and massive spaceships. Despite its cute appearance, this is a pure reaction-based skill game that demands sharp focus and lightning-fast decisions.

With simple controls and randomly generated threats, every attempt feels fresh. Missiles spawn dynamically, meaning there's no fixed pattern—you’ll have to rely on quick reflexes and adaptation rather than memorization.

Playtime depends on your skill and determination.
Some players may breeze through stages quickly, but for most, it will take multiple attempts to hone their reactions and clear the escalating challenges.

Key Features

  • One-hit failure: the ultimate test of skill

  • Simple controls anyone can pick up

  • Randomized missile attacks for ever-changing challenges

  • 8 unique, handcrafted stages

  • A cute yet brutally unforgiving experience

  • Gameplay that rewards focus, fast reactions, and grit

  • A game to flex your skills—or laugh at your friends trying

  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3225, AMD FX-4350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660, ATI Radeon HD 7850
